---
name: Bug Report
about: Report a bug or issue
title: "[BUG]: "
labels: bug
---

# <Issue Title>

## Problem
Clearly describe the current bug, issue, instability, regression, or unexpected behavior.

Explain:
- where the issue exists
- how it can be reproduced
- what negative impact it causes

## Proposed Solution
Describe the expected fix or improvement.

Include:
- files/components involved
- expected behavior after fix
- possible implementation direction if known

## Trade-offs
Mention any implementation considerations, limitations, or risks.

Examples:
- rendering impact
- pagination stability
- browser compatibility concerns
- required testing scenarios

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Bug is reproducible before fix
- [ ] Issue is resolved after implementation
- [ ] Existing behavior remains stable
- [ ] No regressions are introduced
- [ ] Performance and UX remain unaffected
